Lubiw1981.title: Some NP-complete problems similar to graph isomorphism
Lubiw1981.status: DOI verified via search; statement used: existence of a fixed-point-free automorphism (equivalently a fixed-point-free element of a permutation group given by generators) is NP-complete; in her reduction every FPF automorphism is an involution (per arXiv 2603.26006)

BuchheimCameronWu2009.title: On the subgroup distance problem
BuchheimCameronWu2009.status: DOI verified; Hamming-distance subgroup distance problem NP-complete even for H abelian of exponent 2 (Theorem 1 of ECCC TR06-146)

CameronWu2010.title: The complexity of the weight problem for permutation and matrix groups
CameronWu2010.status: DOI verified; weight problem NP-complete for many metrics; FPF element in a permutation group NP-complete (Section 4), even for elementary abelian 2-groups with small orbits

LohreyRosowskiZetzsche2022.title: Membership problems in finite groups
LohreyRosowskiZetzsche2022.journal: MFCS 2022, LIPIcs 241, 71:1-71:16; journal version J. Algebra 2025
LohreyRosowskiZetzsche2022.status: verified; membership in a product of three cyclic permutation groups is NP-complete (knapsack with n>=3)

LohreyRosowski2025.title: Finding cycle types in permutation groups with few generators
LohreyRosowski2025.status: verified via arXiv abstract: 'permutation of given cycle type in a permutation group' is NP-complete even for 2-generated abelian groups; logspace for cyclic groups

Breusch1932.title: Zur Verallgemeinerung des Bertrandschen Postulates (primes = 2 mod 3 in (n,2n))
